nodes.name: Hydrazone COF synthesis
nodes.procedure: Isostructural hydrazone-linked COFs (DETH-COF, BBT-COF, BHT-COF, BOT-COF) synthesized by condensation of hydrazide- and aldehyde-containing monomers via reversible Schiff base formation reaction. Detailed synthesis procedures available in Supporting Information.
nodes.source_text: Four isostructural hydrazone-linked COFs (designated as DETH-COF, BBT-COF, BHT-COF, and BOT-COF) were synthesized from the condensation of hydrazide- and aldehyde-containing monomers (Figure 2a)

unit_operations.name: Schiff base condensation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: synthesized by a well-known reversible reaction of Schiff base formation... from the condensation of hydrazide- and aldehyde-containing monomers

nodes.description: Photocatalytic H₂O₂ production from water oxidation under visible light in pure water
nodes.source_text: The photocatalytic performances of DETH-COF, BBT-COF, BHT-COF, and BOT-COF toward water oxidation were evaluated in pure water under visible-light irradiation... The average rates of H₂O₂ generation were quantified as 1665, 923, 833, and 390 μmol g⁻¹ h⁻¹... The apparent quantum yield of DETH-COF for H₂O₂ production was 0.063% at 450 nm. Continuous H₂O₂ generation in air in 24 h indicates the high stability of DETH-COF.

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR spectroscopy confirmed the chemical structures of DETH-COF, BBT-COF, BHT-COF, and BOT-COF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The chemical structures of the four COFs were confirmed by Fourier transform infrared (FT-IR) spectroscopy (Figure S1)

nodes.characterization_summary: Solid-state 13C NMR confirmed the chemical structures of DETH-COF, BBT-COF, BHT-COF, and BOT-COF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: and solid-state 13C nuclear magnetic resonance (13C NMR) (Figure S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: Thermogravimetric analysis showed all four COFs were thermally stable up to 350°C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Thermogravimetric analysis showed that all the four COFs were thermally stable up to 350°C (Figure S3).

nodes.characterization_summary: Powder X-ray diffraction showed crystallinity with main peaks at 2.3-2.4° corresponding to (100) facet, consistent with simulated patterns.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The crystallinity of the four COFs was determined by powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD). ... The experimental PXRD patterns of all the four COFs were consistent with the simulated PXRD pattern

nodes.characterization_summary: Nitrogen adsorption showed type IV isotherms; BET surface areas were 1335.12, 1029.60, 795.02, and 963.91 m²g⁻¹ for DETH-COF, BBT-COF, BHT-COF, and BOT-COF respectively.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The porosity of the four COFs was assessed by nitrogen adsorption. ... The Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) surface areas of the four COFs were 1335.12, 1029.60, 795.02, and 963.91 m²g⁻¹

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM showed sea urchin-like structure for DETH-COF; BBT-COF, BHT-COF, and BOT-COF composed of irregular particles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images showed a sea urchin like structure of DETH-COF (Figure S7), while BBT-COF, BHT-COF, and BOT-COF were composed of irregular particles.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ DRIFTS showed C-OH peak at ~1030 cm⁻¹ on DETH-COF surface increasing with reaction time, indicating carbinolamine intermediate formation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A signature C-OH peak at around 1030 cm⁻¹ emerged, and the intensity increased gradually with reaction time in spectra of DETH-COF from in situ diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform spectroscopy (DRIFTS) (Figure 5a).

nodes.characterization_summary: Room-temperature EPR of DETH-COF showed weak Lorentzian line (g=2.0034) in dark increasing under light irradiation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Room-temperature electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectra of DETH-COF in the dark exhibited a weak single Lorentzian line with a g value equivalent to 2.0034 (Figure S11), which was assigned to lone pair electrons in the framework. The amplitude of the peak increased remarkably under light irradiation
